# Petya Andromeda D13: D10 with the two families D12 got worse on, keeping all others

D10 stays the group's D after D11 (only weak families: permissions lost) and D12 (all families evenly: codes lost)
were rejected. D13 continues D10 on the familiar cases once, plus fresh dialogues 21–40 of code and quote and 21–30
of the other seven families from `requirements-draft-d12/fresh-train.jsonl` — 911 presentations at lr 5e-7. It is the
first stage kept on the Kingston SSD: `Train Petya.app` runs `execution.json` into
`/Volumes/KINGSTON/petya-train/andromeda-d13`, parent `/Volumes/KINGSTON/petya-train/andromeda-d10/adapter`.
Gate: replaces D10 only if not worse than D10 on any set (46/54, 28+8/42, 797/801).
